title: Simplify dashboard with placeholder values and add admin reset feature

requirements.text: Update the Dashboard page to display placeholder values (0 or sensible fixed numbers) for all usage statistics instead of the current incorrect values (9114). This includes: Usage This Week, Tools Used This Week, Total Usage, Saved Tools, Daily Quota remaining, daily uses, Weekly Quota remaining, weekly uses, Today's Usage, and Average Daily.

quotes: Dashboard display: just show placeholder values until we implement full tracking later

acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard displays 0 or clean placeholder values for all usage metrics
No incorrect or inflated numbers like 9114 appear
All quota fields show placeholder values indicating the tracking system is not yet implemented
UI remains visually consistent and professional with placeholder data

requirements.text: Create an admin panel page for resetting user usage statistics. The admin should be able to select a user and reset all their usage counts (daily usage, weekly usage, total usage, saved tools count) back to zero.

quotes: please include a reset quota/ counter features to do by admin any time
Reset granularity: You may decide with elementory/ easiest approach

acceptanceCriteria: Admin panel includes a new 'Reset User Stats' page
Admin can select a user from a list or search
A reset button clears all usage counts for the selected user
Confirmation dialog appears before resetting to prevent accidental data loss
Success message confirms the reset operation completed

requirements.text: Add backend data structures to support future usage tracking implementation. Create stable types and storage for user usage records (timestamp, tool ID, user ID) without implementing automatic tracking logic yet.

quotes: Basic backend structure to store usage data (prepared for future tracking implementation)

acceptanceCriteria: Backend defines stable data types for usage records
Storage structures exist to hold usage data when tracking is implemented
Admin reset functionality can clear stored usage data
Data structures are designed to support future daily/weekly quota tracking

constraints: Do not implement automatic usage tracking or quota enforcement yet
Keep all Motoko logic in the single main actor file (backend/main.mo)
Do not modify immutable frontend paths: useInternetIdentity hooks, useActor.ts, main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui directory
Admin authentication must use the existing AdminAuthGuard and useAdminAuth system
nonGoals: Automatic tracking of tool usage submissions
Quota enforcement that blocks users when limits are reached
Weekly/daily reset timers or scheduled tasks
Different quota limits per tool or user tier
Migration.mo file (not needed for this modification)
